json_value.description: Actual JSON value, preserving its type. Objects and arrays must not be encoded as strings. The task object's fixed local schema further constrains the value.

value.description: Actual JSON value matching schema. For an object schema pass an object such as {"stage":"initial"}, NOT a JSON-encoded string. Do not JSON.stringify this field. String values are valid only when the schema allows strings.

Actual JSON value matching the existing object's fixed schema. Read the object first. For an object schema pass {"stage":"updated"}, NOT a string containing serialized JSON. Do not JSON.stringify this field. String values are valid only when the fixed schema allows strings.
Actual JSON value; do not JSON.stringify objects or arrays.
